fieldEvidence.excerpt: CADSI's official mandate material describes a national defence, security, and emerging-technology industry association that connects industry and government and supports policy, procurement, and industrial-base outcomes.
The mandate page says CADSI represents Canadian defence, security, and emerging-technology companies to decision-makers and works on policy, investment, procurement, and industrial growth.

The official CANSEC page identifies CADSI as producer of an annual Ottawa event showcasing technologies, products, and services for land, naval, aerospace, joint-force, security, and special-operations communities.

CADSI's SMB support page describes CAF Outlooks and Cyber and Digital Outlooks as structured venues for insight into defence priorities, cyber and digital initiatives, procurement programs, and relevant decision-makers.
CADSI presents Gateway as a structured digital platform for capability visibility, market intelligence, supplier discovery, and strengthened participation in Canadian and allied supply chains.

The International Program page describes CADSI support for Canadian defence and security community participation at major global events through Canada Pavilion presence, delegation support, and market access.
The official CANSEC contact listing gives CADSI an Ottawa, Ontario address and identifies CANSEC as a CADSI-produced event.
